memory_update.text: AJINY should be retained as the reference anchor for ABF insulating film, but group-level purity is a major underwriting issue because Ajinomoto is not a pure semiconductor materials company.

MECGF is the highest-priority underfollowed candidate for this node because copper-to-resin adhesion chemistry maps directly to FC-BGA substrate yield and has OTC US tradability, but liquidity and disclosure quality must be checked.
ESI is a plausible US-listed second-order chemistry candidate via MacDermid Alpha IC-substrate fabrication chemistry; it needs customer and revenue-mix verification before moving beyond Layer 1.

ONTO is a yield/process-control candidate rather than a materials supplier; include only if the research pass allows inspection, metrology, and defect analytics vendors tied to advanced IC substrates.

For this node, separate direct substrate-material chokepoints from HBM-stack tools: ABF insulating film and copper adhesion chemistry are exposed to accelerator package count and package complexity, not pure HBM bit growth.

node: FC-BGA package substrate materials, insulating film, and copper adhesion chemistry
summary: Expanded the US-tradable universe around the FC-BGA package-substrate materials and yield node. The strongest direct reference exposure is Ajinomoto via its OTC ADR because ABF is the dominant insulating film used in high-performance semiconductor package substrates. The strongest underfollowed chokepoint candidate is MEC Company via OTC ordinary shares because its copper-to-resin adhesion chemistry is directly tied to package-substrate yield. Element Solutions is a US-listed underfollowed second-source/adjacent chemistry candidate through MacDermid Alpha circuitry and IC-substrate process chemistries. Onto Innovation is included as a yield-enabling process-control vendor for advanced IC substrates and panel-level packaging rather than as a materials supplier.
